blocks.html: Cabo Fishing Calendar – Best Time to Fish in San José del Cabo

Planning a fishing trip to Los Cabos? Our Cabo fishing calendar helps you discover which fish species are commonly targeted throughout the year in San José del Cabo.

From striped marlin and yellowfin tuna to dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo, and roosterfish, fishing opportunities change with the seasons, water temperatures, bait availability, and ocean conditions.

Exotic Fish Cabo offers private 6-hour and 8-hour fishing charters departing exclusively from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, Mexico. Guests staying in Cabo San Lucas are welcome to book.

Explore our month-by-month fishing guide below to help choose the right time for your adventure. This calendar describes typical seasonal patterns, not guaranteed catches or daily fishing conditions.

San José del Cabo Fishing Seasons at a Glance

Period/Common fishing opportunities

January–March Striped marlin, yellowfin tuna, snapper, grouper

April–June Roosterfish, marlin, dorado, wahoo

July–September Blue and black marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado

October–December Yellowfin tuna, marlin, wahoo, dorado

Fishing opportunities vary with seasonal conditions, water temperature, bait availability, and weather. This calendar is a general guide, not a guarantee of catches.

Fishing San Jose del Cabo in January:

Dreaming of a winter escape to Cabo? January is prime time for sport fishing, offering a bounty of opportunities. Whether you're fishing for Striped Marlin, Yellowfin Tuna, Wahoo, or Mahi-Mahi, this month has it all. It’s also perfect for casting lines from the shore, where you can hook Rooster Fish, Jack Crevalle, Spanish Mackerel, and African Pompano.

The waters around San Jose Del Cabo are particularly inviting, with calm seas, pleasant temperatures, and gentle breezes. Plus, it’s whale breeding season, so you might catch a glimpse of majestic Humpback and Gray Whales adding to the scenic splendor. Whether you’re a seasoned angler or just looking for a relaxing day on the water, Cabo in January delivers an unforgettable fishing adventure surrounded by breathtaking natural beauty and vibrant marine life.

Fishing San Jose del Cabo in February:

February in Cabo is a prime time for fishing, offering a smorgasbord of options for enthusiasts. If you’re into bottom fishing, you can expect great catches of Snapper, Grouper, and Bonito. Yellowfin Tuna are also making their rounds, making it a rewarding month for Tuna lovers. Striped Marlin fishing remains strong, and coastal spots are teeming with Roosterfish. Beyond fishing, it's also the perfect season for whale watching, with Humpback and Gray Whales making their grand appearances. Whether you're a seasoned angler or just starting out, February in Cabo offers exceptional fishing opportunities and the chance to witness majestic whales in the stunning Cabo landscape.

​Fishing San Jose del Cabo in March:

As temperatures heat up in Cabo this March, it’s prime time for bottom fishing, with the chance to hook Snapper, Grouper, Bonito, and Rainbow Runners. The month doesn’t stop there—exciting catches like Wahoo, Mahi-Mahi, and Yellowfin Tuna are all on the table, and Striped Marlin fishing is stellar too. For those who prefer casting from shore, Roosterfish are in their element, thanks to the warmer waters. Whether you’re into bottom fishing or shore casting, March in Cabo offers a perfect blend of great weather and even better fishing.

​Fishing San Jose del Cabo in April:

April offers a variety of fishing opportunities around San José del Cabo. Depending on ocean conditions, anglers may target snapper, grouper, amberjack, yellowfin tuna, wahoo, and striped marlin.

As spring progresses, fishing patterns change with water temperatures, currents, and bait activity. Our private charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina, with fishing locations selected according to the conditions and your target species. No particular catch is guaranteed.

​Fishing San Jose del Cabo in May:

In May, Cabo undergoes a major change in its fishing scene as the winds flip from the North to the South. This marks the beginning of the exciting Black and Blue Marlin season, as well as the kick-off of the renowned Roosterfish season. We’re passionate experts in targeting these epic fish, guaranteeing that every angler enjoys an unforgettable adventure on Cabo’s waters.

​Fishing San Jose del Cabo in June:

Fishing in Cabo mid-year is nothing short of epic. The waters come alive with a variety of fish, with Mahi and Wahoo making a splash closer to shore and Marlin making their presence felt. It’s also prime time for landing Roosterfish, especially in the mornings when you can tangle with ones over 50 pounds. Get ready for some serious thrills—join our team and take on the challenge of reeling in a giant "Roosta"!

Fishing San Jose del Cabo in July:

Summer in San Jose del Cabo is where the fishing action truly heats up. The shores are teeming with massive Roosterfish, often weighing in at over 50 pounds, and it’s not unusual to hook into giants ranging from 70 to 90 pounds. This is also the peak season for Blue and Black Marlin, cranking up the excitement even further. With Mahi and Yellowfin Tuna in high demand, July becomes the perfect time to go after these prized catches. All in all, summer is the absolute best time to experience the thrill of fishing in Cabo.

Fishing San Jose del Cabo in August:

August is the ultimate month for Marlin fishing in Cabo, with Black and Blue Marlin showing up in force, plus a few Striped Marlin making their appearance in the deep blue. Watching these majestic creatures in their element is a real highlight of the season. As the month rolls on, coastal fishing slows down since the Giant Roosters have moved back to deeper waters after spawning. That’s your cue to dive into pelagic fishing—target Marlin, Mahi Mahi, Yellowfin Tuna, and Wahoo in Cabo’s rich, open waters.

Fishing San Jose del Cabo in September:

As summer winds down in Cabo, Marlin action is still going strong, and September is prime time for it. Black and Blue Marlin are in full swing, making it a dream month for Marlin enthusiasts. Yellowfin Tuna also make a big appearance, giving anglers even more exciting options. Mahi and Wahoo are still hot on the list, too. With so many top-tier fish to chase, September is a standout month for fishing in Cabo.

Fishing San Jose del Cabo in October:

October in Cabo is electric—it's the heart of the tournament season for Black and Blue Marlin and giant Yellowfin Tuna. This time of year draws in passionate anglers eager to compete and showcase their skills. At Exotic Fish Cabo, we're all about Marlin and Tuna fishing. Our expert captain will tailor your adventure to ensure you have an unforgettable experience. With plenty of trophy fish on the line this October, it's the ideal moment to head to Cabo and put your fishing prowess to the test.

​Fishing San Jose del Cabo in November:

November is the perfect month for fishing in Cabo! The waters are calm and the winds are gentle, making it prime time to chase after Striped Marlin, Yellowfin Tuna, and Mahi-mahi. Plus, it's an amazing season for whale watching—Humpbacks and Gray Whales are making their way to the Sea of Cortez to breed. With its peaceful vibe and rich marine life, November is a fantastic time for anyone who loves fishing or nature.

​Fishing San Jose del Cabo in December:

San Jose del Cabo is the ultimate winter spot for a family fishing adventure. While you can reel in Wahoo, Yellowfin Tuna, and Striped Marlin anytime, these fish are especially plentiful from November to April. Kids will love the thrill of catching smaller Roosterfish, which are plentiful in the coastal waters. And don’t be surprised if you spot Gray and Humpback whales just a mile off the beach—they’re often seen right in the area, making your family trip even more unforgettable.

​Ready to plan your fishing trip in San José del Cabo?

Our experienced local captains help guests explore seasonal fishing opportunities for marlin, tuna, dorado, wahoo, roosterfish, and other species.

Cabo Fishing Calendar: Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best month for fishing in Cabo?

Fishing is possible throughout the year in Los Cabos, but the best month depends on the species you want to target. Striped marlin are often associated with cooler months, while dorado and blue marlin are commonly targeted during warmer periods. Yellowfin tuna and wahoo fishing opportunities vary with ocean conditions and seasonal activity.

Can you go fishing in San José del Cabo year-round?

Yes. Private sportfishing charters operate throughout the year when weather and sea conditions permit. Different species may be available in different seasons, and no particular catch can be guaranteed.

Where do Exotic Fish Cabo fishing charters depart?

All Exotic Fish Cabo charters depart exclusively from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, Baja California Sur, Mexico. We welcome guests staying in both San José del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas, but departures do not take place from Cabo San Lucas Marina.
